name: [🎃] Sky Mansion Tycoon!
desc:
🎊Welcome to Sky Mansion Tycoon!
Start small and build the ultimate floating city! Expand your islands, fly with your friends, collect resources, and build your mansions!

💾 Auto-saving progress.
🔁 Rebirth system to progress faster.
🤗 Playing with friends gives everyone bonuses! (30% per friend)
🎟️ Special passes with exclusive perks!
👍 Like and favorite the game to earn free cash!
🐦 Follow developers for rewards!

🔓 Redeem codes to get boosts:
BIONOMIC, MANSION, CODECASH, SKY

🫂 Join our group and stay up to date with the latest news and future games!
